status: post-hoc analysis on cached outputs (not pre-registered). Follow-up to the 2026-11-09 independence-model replay, chosen by tony after it: replaces the conditional-independence routing likelihood by a dependence-aware joint table; arms A/B/C2/D only; no new API calls

settings.budget_definition: fraction of the D_init mean full five-verifier panel cost (estimated USD, processable D_init tasks), converted to USD and frozen per rotation
settings.eta_schedule: eta_n = eta0 / sqrt(1 + n), n = number of earlier confidence updates in this run
settings.eta0_selection: simulation only (reports/quantum_katas_online_20261109/sim/eta_sweep.json): grid {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1,3,10}, scenarios ci_known/biased_conf/biased_lik, q in {0.5,0.1}, 12 seeds; criterion = mean stream Brier of arm B over scenarios and q; 0.01 minimizes it (0.1722; 0.03: 0.1726; 0.1: 0.1753). Larger eta0 fixes overconfidence faster with labels but amplifies Z-hat noise and theta bias.
settings.bins: 3 equal-width bins on [0,1]; audit code A in {0, 1/2, 1}
settings.calibrator: p = sigmoid(a + b logit(clip(r, 1e-3, 1-1e-3))), a in [-10,10], b in [0,10], projected after each step; init = Brier minimization (L-BFGS-B, fixed multi-start)
settings.c2_gamma_schedule: gamma_n = 1/(N0 + n), N0 = complete D_init panels
settings.hierarchy_rule: ordered triple with the highest fitted DesignRouting publication on D_init reports under (phi_0, theta_0); ties lexicographic in verifier order
settings.audit_verifier_rule: minimize E[Var(A|Y)]/gap^2 under the unconstrained labeled D_init fit among verifiers with gap >= gamma; else the largest gap
settings.design_routing: exact tree values, column generation from {release-all, abstain-all}, eps 1e-9, max 200 rounds, HiGHS LP
settings.missing_scores: a missing verifier score during routing abstains (logged); theta updates use complete panels only; phi update needs the audit verifier's score
settings.processable: extractable code and raw r in [0,1]; non-processable tasks abstain, are not audited, count in the publication denominator

roles: rotation k: D_init = fold k, D_design = fold (k+1) mod 5, stream = other three folds

seeds.per_run: SeedSequence([master, rotation, order]) -> stream permutation, u_rule, u_audit (shared by all arms, generators and q)

likelihood.description: per class y, joint bin table over the routing hierarchy: T[y] = (C[y] + alpha prod_k g[h_k,y]) / (n_y + alpha), as in vgx.gpqa.dependence_triples; verifiers outside the hierarchy independent given Y; Z-hat uses the constrained audit marginal g[a] as before
likelihood.alpha_selection: per rotation and per verifier set, on D_init complete panels only: inner 5-fold CV class-conditional log-likelihood of held-out cells; inf (independence) is a candidate; ties go to the larger alpha; alpha then frozen for the run (C2/D update counts, not alpha)
likelihood.hierarchy_rule: ordered triple with the highest fitted DesignRouting publication on D_init reports under (phi_0, g_0, T_0)
